definition: A simplified variant of the LSTM that uses fewer gates while still addressing long-range dependency issues in sequence modeling.
details: GRUs merge the LSTM's forget and input gates into a single update gate, offering comparable performance with fewer parameters in many tasks.
story: Imagine a factory floor where each workstation can glance at every other workstation before doing its part. It is the blueprint that makes everything else possible. At the bottom of every machine is a design — the shape of it, and how its pieces talk to each other. Structure decides what the model can even express — the blueprint before the bricks. That blueprint is Gated Recurrent Unit.

citation.title: Learning Phrase Representations using RNN Encoder-Decoder for Statistical Machine Translation
